name: ESO 77-14 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 77-14, a pair of interacting galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: eso7714-hubble
story: Two similar-sized galaxies caught in a gravitational dance, linked by a bridge of material, their once-flat disks twisted into three-dimensional shapes. Hubble imaged the pair in a survey of luminous infrared galaxies.

claims.text: ESO 77-14 is a pair of similar-sized interacting galaxies
A bridge of material links the two galaxies, whose disks have been distorted into three-dimensional shapes
ESO077-IG014 is a target of an ACS survey of luminous infrared galaxies
